coverage_profiles.subject: the Egyptian expeditions to Punt

tuples.episode_object: a cedar deck plank reused as shoring in a harbour gallery
tuples.time_place_scope: Mersa Gawasis on the Red Sea coast, Twelfth Dynasty Egypt
tuples.mechanism: ships were built on the Nile, carried across the desert in pieces and rebuilt at sea
tuples.evidence_lens: timber species named in excavation reports set against cedar consignments in Levantine trade texts

tuples.episode_object: a relief block showing myrrh trees lifted in baskets onto a ship
tuples.time_place_scope: Deir el-Bahri at Thebes, the fifteenth century BCE
tuples.mechanism: a temple advertised state purchase as homage, turning an exchange into a claim of submission
tuples.evidence_lens: temple relief captions read beside the annals of a later king listing incense receipts

tuples.episode_object: an annal fragment recording a delivery of antyu resin by measure
tuples.time_place_scope: Memphis under Sahure, Fifth Dynasty Egypt
tuples.mechanism: royal annals counted resin by volume, tying a reign's standing to the cargo it landed
tuples.evidence_lens: annal fragments in two museum collections checked against temple accounts of resin issues

tuples.episode_object: a rock-cut graffito naming the men and donkeys sent into the hills
tuples.time_place_scope: the Wadi Hammamat road from Coptos, Eleventh Dynasty Egypt
tuples.mechanism: desert crossings needed water stations and thousands of carriers drawn off the fields
tuples.evidence_lens: quarry graffiti tallies weighed against conscription lists from the river towns that supplied them

tuples.episode_object: a wooden cargo box lid inscribed as goods of the southern land
tuples.time_place_scope: Coptos on the Nile, the Middle Kingdom around 1900 BCE
tuples.mechanism: labelled crates let scribes audit a returning cargo before it entered the royal store
tuples.evidence_lens: box labels from a harbour dig placed against storehouse ledgers written on temple papyri

tuples.episode_object: a shoreline house drawn on posts beside a stand of incense trees
tuples.time_place_scope: the southern Red Sea shore, the second millennium BCE
tuples.mechanism: coastal hosts set the terms, trading resin and ivory for beads, weapons and cloth
tuples.evidence_lens: relief depictions of dwellings tested against excavated house plans on the African coast

tuples.episode_object: a papyrus roll listing incense, gold and ebony among temple endowments
tuples.time_place_scope: Thebes under Ramesses III, the twelfth century BCE
tuples.mechanism: endowment lists folded far voyages into temple income, paying priests from imported resin
tuples.evidence_lens: a great endowment papyrus read against the mortuary temple inscriptions on the same donations

tuples.episode_object: a limestone anchor stacked in a rock gallery above a beach
tuples.time_place_scope: Ain Sukhna on the Gulf of Suez, the Twelfth Dynasty
tuples.mechanism: fleets were stored in rock galleries between voyages, so ports were seasonal, not standing
tuples.evidence_lens: anchor types from two harbours matched to the sailing seasons named in expedition texts

tuples.episode_object: a tomb autobiography counting the caravans a governor brought home
tuples.time_place_scope: Elephantine at the First Cataract, Sixth Dynasty Egypt
tuples.mechanism: frontier governors ran caravans as licensed private ventures and kept a share of the return
tuples.evidence_lens: tomb autobiographies read against the royal letters copied onto the same tomb walls

tuples.episode_object: a bill of exchange drawn between two fair towns

tuples.episode_object: a decree closing a foreign trading yard

tuples.episode_object: an interloper's cargo list seized at a quay

tuples.episode_object: a state-built hull handed over with silver capital

tuples.time_place_scope: the imperial court at Dadu, 1293
tuples.mechanism: writing duties into numbered clauses let clerks charge without asking a superior each time

tuples.episode_object: a customs scale used to weigh incoming aromatics
tuples.time_place_scope: Guangzhou and the southern approaches, the 1290s
tuples.mechanism: fine goods paid one tenth and coarse goods less, so classification decided the tax bill

tuples.episode_object: a closure notice nailed to a shuttered office

tuples.mechanism: offices were merged and shut as revenue shifted, so a harbour could lose its legal standing

tuples.episode_object: a silted channel marker at an estuary mouth

tuples.episode_object: a bilingual gravestone from a foreign merchant quarter

tuples.mechanism: foreign merchants held office and paid duties, so the tax system ran on their own networks

tuples.episode_object: a confiscated cargo list from a coastal seizure
tuples.time_place_scope: the second prohibition and the smuggling coast, 1311 to 1314
tuples.mechanism: prohibition raised the return on smuggling, so enforcement created the profit it chased

tuples.episode_object: a paper note tendered at the customs counter

tuples.episode_object: an idle hull left rotting on the mud

tuples.mechanism: pearl grounds were declared state property, and divers worked to a quota set far away

tuples.mechanism: reopening was sold as relief, yet the restored traffic returned on the state's own terms

tuples.episode_object: a foreign traveller's tally of large ships at anchor
tuples.time_place_scope: the Zayton anchorage described by visitors, the 1340s
tuples.mechanism: outside observers counted hulls, giving a check on figures the tax office could shade

tuples.episode_object: a painted page listing cloaks, feathers and shields owed

tuples.episode_object: a stone bench where judges heard disputes over weights

tuples.mechanism: a court inside the marketplace punished false measures, keeping trade under city rule

tuples.episode_object: an obsidian blade core traded from a highland quarry

tuples.episode_object: a copper axe blade too thin to cut, kept as money
tuples.time_place_scope: the western marches toward Tarascan country, the 1480s

tuples.episode_object: a salt cake pressed from the lake shallows

tuples.mechanism: licensed traders travelled armed and reported what they saw, mixing commerce with scouting

tuples.episode_object: a boundary marker stone dividing two tributary towns

tuples.mechanism: conquest redrew who owed what, and marker stones fixed the parcels each town would render

tuples.episode_object: a sheet of bark paper prepared for a scribe's account
tuples.time_place_scope: Amatlan and the paper-making towns, the 1500s
tuples.mechanism: record keeping needed paper, so whole towns paid their dues in the stuff of accounting

tuples.episode_object: a quetzal feather bundle wrapped for a highland journey

tuples.mechanism: feathers were light and dear, the ideal levy from lands too far to send heavy goods

tuples.episode_object: a collector's staff of office carried into a subject town
tuples.time_place_scope: the Cuauhnahuac district, the 1430s
tuples.mechanism: resident collectors lived among the taxed, turning a distant demand into a daily presence

tuples.mechanism: some provinces paid in war gear, so their dues armed the campaigns that took more land

tuples.time_place_scope: the Tlaxcala frontier, the 1450s to 1510s

tuples.mechanism: new rulers read the old lists and kept the demands, changing only who received them

tuples.episode_object: a bill of lading for cloth shipped under a foreign flag

tuples.episode_object: a stone pillar with royal arms set above a landing beach

tuples.mechanism: markers claimed a coast for a crown that meant to tax passage, not to settle the land

tuples.episode_object: a gold weight set used at a river mouth trading post
tuples.time_place_scope: Sofala, south of the Zambezi mouth, 1505 to 1515
tuples.mechanism: a fixed inland purchase rate held only while rivals were kept off the same rivers

tuples.episode_object: a garrison pay chest ledger from a coastal fort

tuples.mechanism: garrison costs often exceeded the dues collected, so raiding subsidised the station

tuples.episode_object: a convoy muster list for merchantmen sailing under escort

tuples.episode_object: a horse stall partition in the hold of a Gulf trader

tuples.mechanism: warhorse imports were licensed, letting one power decide which inland kingdom rearmed

tuples.episode_object: a blockade station log kept off a strait entrance

tuples.episode_object: a cinnamon peeler knife from a coastal collecting station

tuples.episode_object: a bond receipt for a fine paid to release a detained hull

tuples.episode_object: a river bar sounding page from a pilot chart book

tuples.episode_object: a customs farm lease posted for the dues of a river port

tuples.mechanism: where the crown could not garrison, it farmed dues to whoever could collect them

tuples.episode_object: a burnt hull timber from a ship taken for sailing unlicensed
tuples.time_place_scope: the Gujarat coast off Surat, 1613
tuples.mechanism: seizing a great ship brought reprisals ashore, showing the paper rested on a fragile bargain

tuples.episode_object: a sugar mill roller from an island estate that provisioned the fort

tuples.episode_object: a bundle of cotton cloths bought in one river port to sell in another

tuples.episode_object: a treaty stone marking ground rented from a coastal ruler

coverage_profiles.subject: the Kongo kingdom and the Portuguese trade

tuples.episode_object: a royal letter sealed with a Christian monogram
tuples.time_place_scope: Mbanza Kongo, the 1490s
tuples.mechanism: a court used baptism and letters to bargain as an equal, asking for smiths and priests
tuples.evidence_lens: royal correspondence copies in Lisbon read against missionary reports from the capital

tuples.episode_object: a sugar mill roller from an island plantation
tuples.time_place_scope: Sao Tome, in the Gulf of Guinea, the 1510s
tuples.mechanism: an island estate economy created steady demand for captives from the mainland kingdoms
tuples.evidence_lens: island mill inventories compared with baptismal registers of enslaved people landed there

tuples.episode_object: a ship's licence to load captives at the river mouth
tuples.time_place_scope: the Mpinda anchorage at the Congo river mouth, the 1520s
tuples.mechanism: permits fixed who could load, so royal favour rather than price decided who profited
tuples.evidence_lens: shipping licences in the crown archive set against arrival lists at the island depot

tuples.episode_object: a customs ledger page for cargoes out of Africa
tuples.time_place_scope: Lisbon and its overseas revenue office, the 1530s
tuples.mechanism: a fifth taken at home turned distant bargains into a reliable line in a royal budget
tuples.evidence_lens: revenue office ledgers compared with private merchant account books for the same voyages

tuples.episode_object: a fort's foundation stone at a new coastal town
tuples.time_place_scope: Luanda, founded on the Angolan coast, the 1570s
tuples.mechanism: a rival coastal base let outsiders bypass the inland court and deal with lesser chiefs
tuples.evidence_lens: fort building accounts set against tribute lists the inland court kept in the same years

tuples.episode_object: a set of iron trade bars from an interior market
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kwango valley markets, the 1580s
tuples.mechanism: imported metal bars became a unit of account, letting brokers price people against goods
tuples.evidence_lens: metallurgical study of trade bars compared with market tolls noted in mission diaries

tuples.episode_object: a provincial governor's staff of office
tuples.time_place_scope: Nsundi province, the 1540s
tuples.mechanism: provincial governors held the caravan roads and took a share of every passing load
tuples.evidence_lens: governor appointment lists read against court complaints about intercepted caravans

tuples.episode_object: a wooden canoe paddle from a river fair landing
tuples.time_place_scope: the Malebo Pool trading fairs, the 1550s
tuples.mechanism: river fairs pooled captives from many polities, hiding origin and easing later resale
tuples.evidence_lens: fair-day descriptions in mission letters compared with ship registers of embarkation points

tuples.episode_object: a branding iron used at a coastal holding pen
tuples.time_place_scope: Benguela, on the southern Angolan shore, the 1610s
tuples.mechanism: marking at the shore split ownership from capture, so violence stayed inland and unseen
tuples.evidence_lens: shore-side inventories set against inland raiding accounts in Jesuit correspondence

tuples.episode_object: a queen's treaty draft with clauses on captive returns
tuples.time_place_scope: Matamba, east of the Kwanza, the 1630s
tuples.mechanism: a neighbouring ruler bargained over routes, so local states set terms as well as met them
tuples.evidence_lens: treaty drafts in colonial archives compared with oral traditions recorded in the region

tuples.episode_object: a musket lock recovered from a fortified settlement
tuples.time_place_scope: Ndongo and the Kwanza corridor, the 1620s
tuples.mechanism: guns paid for in captives raised the cost of defence, pushing states to raid to stay armed
tuples.evidence_lens: firearm finds from settlements set against import invoices listing muskets and powder

tuples.episode_object: a count's letter refusing a foreign garrison
tuples.time_place_scope: Soyo, at the coast, the 1660s
tuples.mechanism: a coastal province used its landing places to bargain apart from the inland royal court
tuples.evidence_lens: provincial letters compared with capital decrees on who might trade at the coast

tuples.episode_object: a relic list drawn up after a royal defeat in the field
tuples.time_place_scope: the field at Mbwila, 1665
tuples.mechanism: defeat split one kingdom into rival houses, and each faction sold access to keep fighting
tuples.evidence_lens: post-battle inventories set against succession records kept by the rival royal houses

tuples.episode_object: a printed cloth length used as a coastal currency
tuples.time_place_scope: Cabinda and the Loango coast, the 1690s
tuples.mechanism: cloth measures worked as money, so import gluts cut what a seller could get for a captive
tuples.evidence_lens: cloth import manifests compared with price lists kept by coastal broker families

tuples.episode_object: a chest mark burned into a Brazilian sugar crate
tuples.time_place_scope: Recife and the Brazilian sugar ports, the 1640s
tuples.mechanism: mill demand across the ocean set how many people the coast was asked to supply each year
tuples.evidence_lens: mill output books compared with embarkation tallies at the two main Angolan ports

tuples.episode_object: an embassy's credential letter presented at a foreign court
tuples.time_place_scope: Rome, where a Kongo embassy lodged, the 1510s
tuples.mechanism: diplomacy abroad was a bid to check a partner's abuses by appealing over its head
tuples.evidence_lens: embassy credentials in church archives compared with royal complaints sent to Lisbon

tuples.episode_object: a cathedral tithe book from the royal capital
tuples.time_place_scope: the royal capital renamed Sao Salvador, the 1620s
tuples.mechanism: church dues gathered in shells and cloth turned religion into a second revenue stream
tuples.evidence_lens: tithe books set against shell-currency records kept on the island off the coast

tuples.episode_object: a gathering basket from a lagoon shell fishery
tuples.time_place_scope: the nzimbu shell fisheries off Luanda island, the 1560s
tuples.mechanism: whoever held the shell beds held the money supply, and could devalue a rival's treasury
tuples.evidence_lens: shell-bed yield notes compared with court accounts of prices quoted in shell measures

tuples.episode_object: a garrison muster roll from an inland stone fort
tuples.time_place_scope: the fort at Massangano, the 1580s
tuples.mechanism: inland forts turned trade posts into tax posts, taking from caravans they claimed to guard
tuples.evidence_lens: muster rolls compared with toll receipts issued at the same river crossings

tuples.episode_object: a boundary marker between two highland chiefdoms
tuples.time_place_scope: the Dembos highlands, the 1650s
tuples.mechanism: frontier chiefs played both sides, granting passage to whichever party paid a better rate
tuples.evidence_lens: boundary claims in chiefly petitions set against colonial route maps of the same hills

coverage_profiles.subject: the Spanish conquest of the Americas

tuples.episode_object: a royal licence permitting an expedition at the leader's own expense
tuples.time_place_scope: Santo Domingo on Hispaniola, the 1500s
tuples.mechanism: crown licences shifted the cost and risk onto private partnerships and their creditors
tuples.evidence_lens: licence texts against the notarial debt bonds signed by the same expedition partners

tuples.episode_object: a branding iron used to mark captives taken in a raid
tuples.time_place_scope: Cuba, the 1510s
tuples.mechanism: seizing people in raids supplied the new estates, and marking made a person legally a claim
tuples.evidence_lens: royal raiding licences against island head counts recorded by crown treasury officials

tuples.episode_object: a smelter's tally of gold dust weighed before the royal fifth was taken
tuples.time_place_scope: Panama and the Tierra Firme shore, the 1510s
tuples.mechanism: taxing metal at the smelter made assay stations the choke point of the whole gold economy
tuples.evidence_lens: treasury smelting accounts against notarial records of gold divided among partners

tuples.episode_object: a register sheet listing licensed passengers and goods for a fleet
tuples.time_place_scope: Seville and the offices of the Casa de Contratacion, the 1520s
tuples.mechanism: channelling all traffic through one port let the crown count cargoes and tax them once
tuples.evidence_lens: passenger registers against the port's inbound cargo manifests for the same convoys

tuples.episode_object: a painted tribute roll redrawn to name a new overlord
tuples.time_place_scope: Tenochtitlan in the Valley of Mexico, 1519 to 1521
tuples.mechanism: invaders kept existing tribute lists and changed only who collected, saving years of survey
tuples.evidence_lens: pre-conquest tribute codices against the earliest colonial assessments for those towns

tuples.episode_object: a charter of privileges granted to allied lords for war service
tuples.time_place_scope: Tlaxcala, the 1520s
tuples.mechanism: allied city-states traded troops for exemptions, so invasion ran on local political bargains
tuples.evidence_lens: grants of privilege in Castilian archives against pictorial histories painted by the allied city

tuples.episode_object: a ransom inventory of gold objects weighed and then melted
tuples.time_place_scope: Cajamarca in the northern Andes, 1532
tuples.mechanism: melting worked objects destroyed craft value but made loot divisible among shareholders
tuples.evidence_lens: notarial division lists against metallurgical studies of surviving Andean goldwork

tuples.episode_object: a grant assigning the tribute of named villages to a soldier
tuples.time_place_scope: Cuzco, 1533 to 1535
tuples.mechanism: handing out tribute rather than land let rewards be granted before any survey existed
tuples.evidence_lens: grant registers against village tribute counts taken a decade later by inspectors

tuples.episode_object: an inspection report listing tribute in cloth, salt and gold
tuples.time_place_scope: the Muisca highlands around Bogota, the 1530s
tuples.mechanism: fixing tribute in goods a region already made turned local specialisms into a fiscal quota
tuples.evidence_lens: inspection reports against archaeological evidence for pre-conquest craft production

tuples.episode_object: a pictorial map showing a town's fields and its new church
tuples.time_place_scope: Michoacan, the 1530s
tuples.mechanism: resettlement concentrated dispersed households, easing collection and thinning worked land
tuples.evidence_lens: indigenous pictorial maps against resettlement orders issued by colonial magistrates

tuples.episode_object: a muster list naming allied and Castilian fighters raised against a rising
tuples.time_place_scope: Nueva Galicia during the Mixton risings, 1540 to 1542
tuples.mechanism: revolt was met by mostly allied armies, so invasion kept reproducing the alliances it needed
tuples.evidence_lens: campaign muster lists against petitions later filed by allied towns seeking reward

tuples.episode_object: a friar's parish book recording baptisms and the tribute owed with them
tuples.time_place_scope: Yucatan, the 1540s
tuples.mechanism: parish registration doubled as a tax roll, binding conversion to the counting of taxpayers
tuples.evidence_lens: parish baptism books against grant holders' tribute claims for the same settlements

tuples.episode_object: a sack of dried cochineal insects weighed out for tribute
tuples.time_place_scope: Oaxaca and the Mixteca, the 1540s
tuples.mechanism: demanding a dyestuff as tribute pushed households to produce for a market they never entered
tuples.evidence_lens: tribute assessment lists against dye shipment entries in the Atlantic port registers

tuples.episode_object: a river expedition's ration book kept on the way upstream
tuples.time_place_scope: Asuncion on the Paraguay river, the 1540s
tuples.mechanism: with no metal found, invasion lived on food levied from allied villages, and strained them
tuples.evidence_lens: expedition ration books against later complaints filed by allied village leaders

tuples.episode_object: a printed law book with the clause on inherited grants struck through
tuples.time_place_scope: Valladolid in Castile, 1550 to 1551
tuples.mechanism: rules made in Castile were softened by settler lobbying before reaching the towns they bound
tuples.evidence_lens: printed law texts against the enforcement correspondence of colonial high courts

tuples.episode_object: a silver bar stamped with the assayer's mark and the tax paid
tuples.time_place_scope: Zacatecas in the northern silver country, the 1550s
tuples.mechanism: stamping bars at assay offices made untaxed metal hard to sell, pulling mines into the net
tuples.evidence_lens: assay office stamp records against contraband seizure files from the same road

tuples.episode_object: a stockade plan for a frontier fort, drawn for a governor
tuples.time_place_scope: the Mapuche frontier south of the Bio-Bio, the 1550s
tuples.mechanism: where societies were not tributary states, extraction stalled and forts replaced tax rolls
tuples.evidence_lens: fort plans and garrison payrolls against governors' despatches on refused tribute demands

tuples.episode_object: a sealed flask of mercury readied for the refining yards
tuples.time_place_scope: Huancavelica in the central Andes, the 1560s
tuples.mechanism: command of mercury gave officials a lever over every silver refiner in the viceroyalty
tuples.evidence_lens: mercury distribution ledgers against silver registration totals at the royal treasuries

tuples.episode_object: a diver's weighted rope and basket from a pearl bank
tuples.time_place_scope: the pearl banks of Cubagua, the 1520s
tuples.mechanism: divers worked shifts fixed by boat owners, and the banks were stripped within a generation
tuples.evidence_lens: pearl tax returns against later survey reports on the exhausted oyster beds

tuples.episode_object: a court docket in a suit between a town and its grant holder
tuples.time_place_scope: Mexico City under the second audiencia, the 1530s
tuples.mechanism: courts let communities contest assessments, so tribute levels were argued as well as imposed
tuples.evidence_lens: audiencia case dockets against the tribute schedules those towns filed in their defence

coverage_profiles.subject: the silver mines of Potosi

tuples.episode_object: a viceroy's ordinance sheet setting the yearly quota of drafted villagers
tuples.time_place_scope: Potosi, in Upper Peru, the 1570s
tuples.mechanism: a rotating draft sent a fixed share of village men to the pits each year
tuples.evidence_lens: the quota ordinance compared with parish baptism registers in the draft provinces

tuples.episode_object: a flask of mercury stamped with the royal mark and its weight
tuples.time_place_scope: Huancavelica, in central Peru, 1571 to 1600
tuples.mechanism: state quicksilver was advanced on credit, so refiners owed the treasury first
tuples.evidence_lens: mercury delivery accounts set against refiners' debt suits in the local courts

tuples.episode_object: a stone hand mill and a wind furnace left standing on the upper slopes
tuples.time_place_scope: the Cerro Rico slopes, 1545 to 1560
tuples.mechanism: wind furnaces smelted rich ore locally until the grades fell too low to burn
tuples.evidence_lens: furnace slag analyses read with early Spanish descriptions of native smelting

tuples.episode_object: an assay button kept as proof of what a vein would yield
tuples.time_place_scope: Porco, south of the great mountain, the 1540s
tuples.mechanism: assays fixed which veins were worth the labour and which were left as waste
tuples.evidence_lens: assay records weighed against the mint's own reports of metal received

tuples.episode_object: a bill of lading for bars shipped out through the coast road port
tuples.time_place_scope: Arica, the Pacific silver port, the 1590s
tuples.mechanism: bars moved under guard to one licensed harbour so the royal fifth could be taken
tuples.evidence_lens: port bills of lading matched to arrival manifests filed across the ocean

tuples.episode_object: a notarial power of attorney appointing an agent in the capital
tuples.time_place_scope: Lima, the viceregal capital, 1568
tuples.mechanism: absent owners ran mills through agents, drawing income without nearing the pits
tuples.evidence_lens: notarial agency papers compared with mill ownership entries in the town register

tuples.episode_object: a register folio of bullion declared on arrival across the ocean
tuples.time_place_scope: Seville, at the house of trade, the 1600s
tuples.mechanism: registered bullion paid duty on landing, which is why unregistered metal moved
tuples.evidence_lens: arrival registers tested against later estimates of undeclared bullion

tuples.episode_object: a mill lease naming the water share it carried each week
tuples.time_place_scope: the Ribera mills of Potosi, the 1620s
tuples.mechanism: water rights set milling capacity, so the stream schedule rationed refining
tuples.evidence_lens: mill leases read beside canal maintenance accounts for the same stream

tuples.episode_object: a court petition from village headmen asking relief from the quota
tuples.time_place_scope: La Plata, seat of the audiencia of Charcas, the 1580s
tuples.mechanism: communities could pay cash instead of sending men, turning a draft into a tax
tuples.evidence_lens: village petitions set against treasury records of money paid in lieu of workers

tuples.episode_object: a fair invoice pairing bar metal against imported linen
tuples.time_place_scope: Portobelo, on the isthmus, the 1630s
tuples.mechanism: fleets met once a year, so the fair's timing decided prices on both sides
tuples.evidence_lens: fair invoices compared with fleet cargo lists cleared at the isthmus

tuples.episode_object: a second camp's tax roll showing metal registered away from the old town
tuples.time_place_scope: Oruro, the newer silver camp, the 1600s
tuples.mechanism: a rival camp let miners register metal where the older charges did not reach
tuples.evidence_lens: the new camp's tax roll weighed against declines in the older town's receipts

tuples.episode_object: a coin die cut for the new milled currency
tuples.time_place_scope: the mint of Potosi, the 1750s
tuples.mechanism: milled coining cut clipping and raised what the treasury took from each mark
tuples.evidence_lens: die records checked against surviving coins from dated shipwreck cargoes

tuples.episode_object: a confiscation inventory taken from a smuggler on the southern road
tuples.time_place_scope: the road to Buenos Aires, 1590 to 1620
tuples.mechanism: contraband down the river route escaped the coastal registers and the fifth
tuples.evidence_lens: confiscation inventories set beside river port entry books to the south

tuples.episode_object: a mule contract for hauling bars over the high passes
tuples.time_place_scope: Cordoba, at the mule fairs, the 1620s
tuples.mechanism: mule trains fixed the freight cost that every bar carried down to the sea
tuples.evidence_lens: muleteer contracts compared with freight charges entered in merchant ledgers

tuples.episode_object: a dam breach report listing the mills carried away by the flood
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kari Kari reservoirs above the town, 1626
tuples.mechanism: reservoir water drove the mills, so one breach stopped refining for months
tuples.evidence_lens: the breach report read with parish burial entries whose totals are still disputed

tuples.episode_object: a shipping order for quicksilver flasks bound across the ocean
tuples.time_place_scope: Almaden, in Castile, the 1640s
tuples.mechanism: a European quicksilver mine supplied what the American workings could not
tuples.evidence_lens: shipping orders for flasks matched to mine output books kept in Castile

tuples.episode_object: a parish tribute list marking which households owed a turn underground
tuples.time_place_scope: the sixteen provinces liable to the draft, from 1573
tuples.mechanism: villages named the men, so headmen carried the burden of filling a quota
tuples.evidence_lens: tribute lists compared with hospital and burial records that give disputed ranges

tuples.episode_object: an inspection docket on the state bank's purchases of ore
tuples.time_place_scope: Potosi under the Bourbon reforms, the 1780s
tuples.mechanism: a state bank bought ore from small workers and fixed the price they could get
tuples.evidence_lens: bank purchase dockets set against small producers' complaints to the audiencia

tuples.episode_object: a yard tally of ore, salt and mercury mixed into a single batch
tuples.time_place_scope: Tarapaya and the valley refineries, the 1590s
tuples.mechanism: amalgamation let poor ore pay, which reopened dumps left by earlier smelting
tuples.evidence_lens: yard tallies weighed against surviving refinery structures on the same terraces

tuples.episode_object: a wartime requisition receipt for metal taken from the mint
tuples.time_place_scope: the mountain workings, 1810 to 1825
tuples.mechanism: war cut the quicksilver supply, and output fell with it rather than with the ore
tuples.evidence_lens: requisition receipts read beside coining figures for the same war years

coverage_profiles.subject: the mita labor draft in the Andes

tuples.episode_object: a draft assignment sheet naming villages and their quotas
tuples.time_place_scope: Potosi and its supply provinces, the 1570s
tuples.mechanism: sixteen provinces sent a set share of men yearly, rotating households through the shafts
tuples.evidence_lens: viceregal assignment lists set against village tribute rolls from the same provinces

tuples.episode_object: a mercury flask sealed for shipment to the refineries
tuples.time_place_scope: Huancavelica in central Peru, the 1570s and 1580s
tuples.mechanism: amalgamation needed mercury, so one drafted mine's output set the ceiling of another's silver
tuples.evidence_lens: mercury delivery receipts compared with silver registration entries at the royal treasury

tuples.episode_object: a cash receipt paid in place of a missing draftee
tuples.time_place_scope: the Lupaqa towns of Chucuito, the 1620s
tuples.mechanism: villages short of men paid silver instead, turning a labour levy into a cash tax
tuples.evidence_lens: community cash payment records set against parish head-counts for the same towns

tuples.episode_object: an amalgamation patio where ore was trodden with mercury
tuples.time_place_scope: the Ribera refineries below the mountain, the 1590s
tuples.mechanism: refining moved the value to mill owners who bought ore cheap from the men who dug it
tuples.evidence_lens: refinery ownership registers checked against ore purchase prices in notarial contracts

tuples.episode_object: a stamped silver bar bearing the mark of the crown's fifth
tuples.time_place_scope: the Potosi royal treasury, the 1590s
tuples.mechanism: stamping proved the crown's share was taken, and only stamped metal could lawfully leave
tuples.evidence_lens: treasury stamping registers set against contraband seizure records at the coastal ports

tuples.episode_object: a census roll recounting tributaries after decades of flight
tuples.time_place_scope: the Charcas provinces, the 1680s and 1690s
tuples.mechanism: a recount fixed quotas to who remained, so flight by some raised the burden on the rest
tuples.evidence_lens: recount registers weighed against the earlier assessment lists for the same districts

tuples.episode_object: a llama pack train tally sheet for ore and salt
tuples.time_place_scope: the roads between Porco and the mountain, the 1600s
tuples.mechanism: men on the levy also moved cargo, so haulage cost the mines little and the herders much
tuples.evidence_lens: muleteer contracts set against community livestock counts in visitation records

tuples.episode_object: a shaft hoist windlass with its rope groove worn deep
tuples.time_place_scope: the workings inside Cerro Rico, the 1610s
tuples.mechanism: ore was carried up ladders by men on quotas, so output rose by lengthening the shift
tuples.evidence_lens: mine inspection reports read beside hospital and burial entries in the miners' parish

tuples.episode_object: a parish burial book kept in a silver town
tuples.time_place_scope: the Potosi parishes of San Pablo and Santiago, the 1620s
tuples.mechanism: church registers in the town tracked a population renewed each year by arrivals from far away
tuples.evidence_lens: burial registers set against draft arrival lists, whose mortality totals remain sharply disputed between the historians who count them

tuples.episode_object: a petition from village leaders asking for a smaller quota
tuples.time_place_scope: the audiencia at La Plata, the 1630s
tuples.mechanism: local lords bargained quotas down by proving flight, so the levy was negotiated, not fixed
tuples.evidence_lens: petition dossiers read alongside the reassessment decrees issued in reply

tuples.episode_object: a wage tally set beside the week's price of maize
tuples.time_place_scope: the town markets of Potosi, the 1650s
tuples.mechanism: pay covered part of a week's food, so home villages sent supplies and subsidised the mine
tuples.evidence_lens: wage schedules compared with market price lists recorded by the town council

tuples.episode_object: an itinerary map of the road from a high lake to the mines
tuples.time_place_scope: the altiplano route from Chucuito to Potosi, the 1600s
tuples.mechanism: draft parties walked for weeks with families and herds, and the journey itself ate the wage
tuples.evidence_lens: route itineraries checked against community accounts of travel provisions

tuples.episode_object: a mill owner's contract hiring drafted men on their rest weeks
tuples.time_place_scope: the refining district of Tarapaya, the 1660s
tuples.mechanism: men off shift were hired out, so a levy meant for the crown's mines subsidised private mills
tuples.evidence_lens: labour lease contracts set against the official rotation schedules for the same weeks

tuples.episode_object: a colonial inspector's questionnaire on abuses in the workings
tuples.time_place_scope: the visita of the southern provinces, the 1610s
tuples.mechanism: inspections gathered testimony on practices the law forbade but the quota quietly required
tuples.evidence_lens: inspection testimony weighed against the standing ordinances the inspectors were checking

tuples.episode_object: a receipt for a substitute hired in a draftee's place
tuples.time_place_scope: Oruro and its hinterland, the 1670s
tuples.mechanism: wealthier households bought replacements, so the burden fell hardest on the poorest families
tuples.evidence_lens: substitution receipts checked against community wealth assessments in the tribute books

tuples.episode_object: a rebel manifesto denouncing the yearly rotation
tuples.time_place_scope: the southern Andes during the risings of 1780 and 1781
tuples.mechanism: rebellion put ending the rotation at the centre of demands, showing what subjects blamed most
tuples.evidence_lens: rebel proclamations set against royal officials' reports on the grievances they collected

tuples.episode_object: a decree from a distant assembly abolishing the levy
tuples.time_place_scope: Cadiz and Upper Peru, 1812 and 1813
tuples.mechanism: abolition on paper met resistance, since mills had built their costs around cheap rotation
tuples.evidence_lens: the abolition decree read beside mine owner petitions asking for its suspension

tuples.episode_object: an ore sample bag drawn from a thin low grade seam
tuples.time_place_scope: the declining workings above Potosi, the 1700s
tuples.mechanism: falling grades meant more men and mercury per bar, so the levy grew as the ore grew poorer
tuples.evidence_lens: assay records set against annual quota totals across the same decades

tuples.episode_object: a ventilation adit cut into a mercury hillside
tuples.time_place_scope: the Santa Barbara workings at Huancavelica, the 1600s
tuples.mechanism: bad air made the mercury workings feared, so recruits fled and the quotas were raised again
tuples.evidence_lens: mine engineering reports read beside parish registers in the mercury town, where mortality estimates diverge widely between studies

tuples.episode_object: a company store account listing coca, cloth and arrears
tuples.time_place_scope: the mining camps of Porco and Berenguela, the 1690s
tuples.mechanism: advances of coca and cloth were charged against pay, so men left a shift owing the store
tuples.evidence_lens: store ledgers matched to wage books for the same workers and seasons

coverage_profiles.subject: the encomienda and the repartimiento

tuples.episode_object: a grant document naming towns and the households that owed tribute
tuples.time_place_scope: Hispaniola, the 1500s and 1510s
tuples.mechanism: a grant conveyed labour and tribute from named towns but never title to their land
tuples.evidence_lens: grant registers set against the island tribute assessments made a decade later

tuples.episode_object: a printed ordinance on work rotations, rations and rest
tuples.time_place_scope: Burgos in Castile, 1512 and 1513
tuples.mechanism: rules written across an ocean set hours and food that holders read as advisory
tuples.evidence_lens: printed ordinances weighed against inspection findings from the towns they governed

tuples.episode_object: a tribute assessment sheet listing cloth and maize due each year
tuples.time_place_scope: the Valley of Mexico, the 1530s
tuples.mechanism: assessments fixed goods per household, so weaving and farming were taxed inside the home
tuples.evidence_lens: assessment sheets compared with the pictorial tribute records kept by the towns themselves

tuples.episode_object: a pictorial roll drawn by a town's own scribes
tuples.time_place_scope: Tlaxcala, the 1550s
tuples.mechanism: allied towns bargained down their terms by proving service, so status set the rate
tuples.evidence_lens: pictorial rolls read against the Spanish-language settlements filed by the same town

tuples.episode_object: a decree ending the inheritance of labour grants
tuples.time_place_scope: Valladolid and the Indies, 1542 to 1545
tuples.mechanism: ending inheritance threatened to make holders a single generation, and they revolted
tuples.evidence_lens: the decree text checked against viceregal correspondence reporting resistance to it

tuples.episode_object: a rotation list assigning villages to weekly work drafts
tuples.time_place_scope: the Valley of Mexico labour drafts, the 1590s
tuples.mechanism: a state office allotted rotating workers at set wages, displacing older private claims
tuples.evidence_lens: rotation lists matched to wage receipts signed at the works those drafts supplied

tuples.episode_object: a workshop debt book setting wages against advances
tuples.time_place_scope: the textile workshops of Puebla, the 1590s
tuples.mechanism: debt held workers in place once drafts were curtailed, changing the form and not the fact

tuples.mechanism: the state built its own lines when the guarantee proved dearer than borrowing directly

tuples.mechanism: strategic lines ran where troops might be needed, not only where freight would pay
tuples.evidence_lens: engineering drawings weighed against military memoranda on movement to the frontier

tuples.mechanism: curing by smoke let one worker prepare a shippable ball far from any settlement

tuples.episode_object: a labour recruiter's advance contract
tuples.time_place_scope: the drought districts of Ceara, the 1870s
tuples.mechanism: drought migrants signed advances that made the journey itself the first debt to repay

tuples.episode_object: a hide bag of barter goods from a trading post

tuples.episode_object: a tyre factory's raw material purchase ledger
tuples.time_place_scope: Akron, in Ohio, the 1900s

tuples.episode_object: a trading post's rifle inventory
tuples.time_place_scope: the Purus river posts, the 1880s
tuples.mechanism: arms held at posts enforced exclusive dealing where no court reached the tappers
tuples.evidence_lens: post inventories set against police complaint files from the nearest district seat

tuples.episode_object: a shareholders' report tabled before an inquiry
tuples.time_place_scope: London, where a company inquiry sat, 1912
tuples.mechanism: investors abroad claimed ignorance of methods that their dividends had quietly rewarded
tuples.evidence_lens: shareholder reports compared with inquiry witness statements and consular despatches

tuples.episode_object: a sealed tin of seeds shipped from a botanic garden
tuples.time_place_scope: Kew and the seed transfer to Asia, 1876
tuples.mechanism: moving seed to new colonies broke a natural monopoly by creating a plantation supply

tuples.episode_object: a nursery bed label from a colonial garden
tuples.time_place_scope: the Henaratgoda plantation in Ceylon, the 1880s
tuples.mechanism: trials in gardens turned a wild tree into a crop that could be planted in straight rows
tuples.evidence_lens: nursery records set against colonial agriculture department annual reports

tuples.episode_object: a herringbone tapping knife from an estate store
tuples.time_place_scope: the tapping trials at the Singapore botanic gardens, the 1890s
tuples.mechanism: a cutting method that kept trees alive made repeat yields possible on planted estates

tuples.episode_object: a mission diary page listing village depopulation
tuples.time_place_scope: the Xingu tributaries, the 1900s
tuples.mechanism: recruitment and disease emptied villages whose people had been tied to tapping quotas

tuples.episode_object: a warehouse receipt for stored latex balls
tuples.time_place_scope: Santarem, on the lower Amazon, the 1870s
tuples.mechanism: warehouse receipts became collateral, letting traders borrow against goods not yet sold
tuples.evidence_lens: warehouse receipts set against bank discount records in the provincial capital

tuples.episode_object: an estate wage docket for a plantation tapper
tuples.time_place_scope: the Selangor estates of Malaya, the 1910s

tuples.evidence_lens: estate wage dockets compared with price series recorded by commodity exchanges

coverage_profiles.subject: the Kimberley diamond fields and amalgamation

tuples.episode_object: a digger's cradle and sorting table on a gravel bank
tuples.time_place_scope: the Vaal river diggings near Klipdrift, 1870 to 1871
tuples.mechanism: river gravels could be worked by one man with a sieve, so entry cost almost nothing at first
tuples.evidence_lens: digger licence stubs against mission station records of arrivals on the river

tuples.episode_object: a canvas claim ticket pegged out on a small surveyed square
tuples.time_place_scope: Colesberg Kopje at the New Rush, 1871
tuples.mechanism: small square claims were meant to keep the field open, and the size cap capped machinery too
tuples.evidence_lens: claim survey diagrams against the diggers' committee rules printed that season

tuples.episode_object: a proclamation of annexation posted at a magistrate's tent
tuples.time_place_scope: Griqualand West at its annexation, 1871
tuples.mechanism: annexation settled which law ran on the diggings and whose land titles would be recognised
tuples.evidence_lens: annexation proclamations against Griqua land title petitions filed before them

tuples.episode_object: a haulage rope and its winding gear above a deepening pit
tuples.time_place_scope: Dutoitspan and Bultfontein, the 1870s
tuples.mechanism: deeper pits needed gear no single claim could pay for, forcing men to sell out or combine
tuples.evidence_lens: equipment purchase invoices against claim transfer entries in the mining registers

tuples.episode_object: a survey drawing of a collapsed reef over buried claim boundaries
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kimberley mine and its falling reef, the mid 1870s
tuples.mechanism: falling rock buried scattered claims, and only combined holdings could afford to clear them
tuples.evidence_lens: reef survey drawings against the insolvency filings of claim holders that season

tuples.episode_object: a magistrate's docket in a dispute over a jumped claim
tuples.time_place_scope: the claim court at Barkly West, the 1870s
tuples.mechanism: courts decided contested claims, so legal costs became a way of squeezing out small holders
tuples.evidence_lens: court dockets against the register of ownership changes in the following months

tuples.episode_object: a select committee report on limits to the number of claims held
tuples.time_place_scope: the Cape parliament sitting at Cape Town, 1875 to 1880
tuples.mechanism: lifting the holding limit legalised a concentration already running through nominee buyers
tuples.evidence_lens: committee evidence against nominee holdings listed in the registers before the change

tuples.episode_object: a register page showing one name written across many squares
tuples.time_place_scope: the claim register office at Kimberley, 1876
tuples.mechanism: recording ownership made concentration visible, and guided who the next buyers approached
tuples.evidence_lens: register pages against the mortgage bonds financing those same purchases

tuples.episode_object: a share prospectus for a company formed out of adjoining claims
tuples.time_place_scope: the mine flotations on the London market, 1880 to 1881
tuples.mechanism: turning claims into shares funded pumping from afar, and diluted the diggers who sold in
tuples.evidence_lens: share prospectuses against the transfer books kept after the market broke

tuples.episode_object: a compound gate pass bearing a worker's contract number
tuples.time_place_scope: the closed compounds at Beaconsfield, 1885
tuples.mechanism: housing workers behind a fence for the contract term cut desertion and cut bargaining power
tuples.evidence_lens: compound gate registers against the labour contracts filed under those numbers

tuples.time_place_scope: the searching houses at the De Beers shaft head, the 1880s
tuples.mechanism: body searches at shift end were justified as theft control and applied only to black workers
tuples.evidence_lens: searching house rules against the racial categories used in the company wage schedules

tuples.episode_object: a trap-buyer's marked stone entered as evidence in court
tuples.time_place_scope: the illicit-buying trials in Griqualand West, 1882
tuples.mechanism: making unlicensed buying a crime turned any stone in a worker's hand into proof of guilt
tuples.evidence_lens: trial transcripts against the licence lists showing who could legally hold a stone

tuples.episode_object: a signed deed folding the last rival mine into one holding
tuples.time_place_scope: the amalgamation deed signed at Kimberley, 1888
tuples.mechanism: merging the mines let one board hold back output so the price would not fall with supply
tuples.evidence_lens: the merger deed against monthly output returns before and after it took effect

tuples.episode_object: a syndicate contract fixing what quantity the market would receive
tuples.time_place_scope: the diamond selling syndicate in London, 1890
tuples.mechanism: selling through one channel matched supply to demand, and the price was set before any sale
tuples.evidence_lens: syndicate contracts against auction realisations reported in the trade press

tuples.episode_object: a migrant's travel pass carried from a chief's district
tuples.time_place_scope: the Pedi and Tsonga labour routes from the northern Transvaal, the 1870s
tuples.mechanism: chiefs sent men to earn cash for taxes and guns, so African polities helped supply the labour
tuples.evidence_lens: pass records against mission diaries describing returns to those home districts

tuples.episode_object: a gun sold to a departing worker at the end of a contract
tuples.time_place_scope: the Basotho gun purchases at the diggings, the 1870s
tuples.mechanism: wages were often taken in firearms, arming home societies and alarming colonial governments
tuples.evidence_lens: trader gun sale books against colonial disarmament correspondence of the same years

tuples.episode_object: a recruiting agent's capitation receipt at a port of departure
tuples.time_place_scope: Delagoa Bay as a migrant embarkation route, the 1880s
tuples.mechanism: paying agents by the head created pressure to recruit hard and to hide the contract terms
tuples.evidence_lens: capitation receipts against Portuguese port emigration registers for those months

tuples.episode_object: an underground timbering plan for the first deep levels
tuples.time_place_scope: the deep shafts under the Kimberley pit, the 1890s
tuples.mechanism: deep mining needed capital and long horizons, cementing the single-owner structure formed
tuples.evidence_lens: underground plans against capital expenditure accounts in the company annual reports

tuples.episode_object: a model village lease binding a skilled worker's family
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kenilworth model village outside Kimberley, the 1890s
tuples.mechanism: housing skilled white workers on company land bought loyalty and split the workforce further

tuples.episode_object: a labour recruiting licence issued for a northern district
tuples.time_place_scope: the recruiting districts of Bechuanaland, the 1890s
tuples.mechanism: licensed recruiters extended the labour catchment far past the colony that held the mines
tuples.evidence_lens: recruiting licences against tax records showing cash demands in the sending districts

tuples.mechanism: a joint wage ceiling stopped employers bidding against each other for men

tuples.time_place_scope: the deep level mines of the central reef, 1895 to 1899
tuples.mechanism: deep ore was low grade, so profit depended on cutting the cost of each shift

tuples.episode_object: a rail freight schedule tying an ocean port to the inland fields

tuples.mechanism: recruiters were paid per head, which pushed them further into the countryside

tuples.episode_object: a migrant's contract sheet counting shifts rather than days
tuples.time_place_scope: Basutoland, the mountain kingdom, the 1900s
tuples.mechanism: contracts counted shifts worked, so absence lengthened a term rather than ending it
tuples.evidence_lens: contract sheets compared with mission station accounts of absent men

tuples.mechanism: a tax payable in cash forced households to send a man out for wages

tuples.mechanism: passes tied a worker to one employer and made leaving a criminal matter
tuples.evidence_lens: pass office tallies set against criminal court returns for pass offences

tuples.episode_object: a patent licence for dissolving fine gold out of crushed rock
tuples.time_place_scope: the cyanide reduction works, 1890 to 1892
tuples.mechanism: a cheap chemical process made low grade ore payable and enlarged labour demand
tuples.evidence_lens: patent licences compared with mill recovery rates in company reports

tuples.episode_object: a repatriation ticket issued to a miner returning after the fighting

tuples.mechanism: after the war wages were cut, and the men who had left did not come back

tuples.episode_object: an indenture form printed in two languages and marked with a thumb print
tuples.time_place_scope: the compounds housing indentured Chinese miners, 1904 to 1910
tuples.mechanism: indentured men were confined to the mines and repatriated at a term's end
tuples.evidence_lens: indenture forms compared with consular inspection reports on the compounds

tuples.episode_object: a commission's dust sampling notebook filled in at the stope face
tuples.time_place_scope: the mining commission on lung disease, 1902 to 1912
tuples.mechanism: dry drilling raised dust, and the dust decided how long a man could work

tuples.episode_object: a martial law proclamation posted at the mine gates
tuples.time_place_scope: Johannesburg, during the strike of 1922
tuples.mechanism: troops at the gates settled who could be replaced and on what terms

tuples.episode_object: a recruiting station's monthly return of men forwarded south

tuples.mechanism: territories competed to supply men because recruiting fees reached local chiefs
tuples.evidence_lens: station returns compared with district commissioners' annual reports

tuples.episode_object: a search room register kept at a closed diamond compound

tuples.mechanism: closed compounds cut theft and cut a worker's ability to bargain as well
tuples.evidence_lens: search room registers weighed against diamond company board minutes

tuples.episode_object: a travel permit for a worker crossing three territories
tuples.time_place_scope: Nyasaland, on the northern labour routes, the 1920s
tuples.mechanism: long routes meant fares and food advanced against wages not yet earned

tuples.episode_object: a deferred pay voucher cashed at home rather than at the mine

tuples.mechanism: holding part of a wage until return made desertion expensive for the worker

tuples.episode_object: a convention article setting the share of recruits and the rail traffic
tuples.time_place_scope: the Portuguese labour convention districts, 1928
tuples.mechanism: a treaty traded recruiting rights for rail traffic and a share of the fees
tuples.evidence_lens: the convention text read with port and rail tonnage series for the same years

tuples.episode_object: a tax receipt for a hut, payable only in coin
tuples.time_place_scope: the Transvaal hut tax rolls, 1895
tuples.mechanism: the tax fell on the homestead, so a family financed the journey to the mines

tuples.episode_object: a shutdown notice and a list of stores left underground

tuples.mechanism: diggers held shares in a pit's yield, so pay turned on the season's ore not a daily rate

tuples.episode_object: a numbered ticket issued to a newly landed labourer

tuples.episode_object: an opium revenue farm lease knocked down at auction
tuples.time_place_scope: Selangor, the 1880s
tuples.mechanism: the state auctioned the right to sell opium, so miners' habits funded the administration

tuples.episode_object: a wooden sluice board lifted from a washing race

tuples.mechanism: gravity washing needed water rights and long races, giving control of streams real cash value

tuples.episode_object: a bucket dredge pontoon moored on flooded ground
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kinta fields around Batu Gajah, the 1910s
tuples.mechanism: dredges worked poor ground with few hands, shifting the trade from labour to capital
tuples.evidence_lens: dredge import records set against mine labour returns for the same districts

tuples.episode_object: a smelter ingot stamped with a refiner's mark
tuples.time_place_scope: Singapore and Penang smelters, the 1900s
tuples.mechanism: smelting away from the pits let a few refiners set the terms on which ore was bought
tuples.evidence_lens: smelter output records checked against mine ore delivery receipts

tuples.episode_object: a mining lease map with its boundaries pegged out
tuples.time_place_scope: Sungei Ujong, the 1880s
tuples.mechanism: written leases displaced customary claims, so registration decided who could work ground
tuples.evidence_lens: lease registers read beside earlier revenue arrangements that residents recorded with chiefs

tuples.episode_object: a hospital admission book from a mining district
tuples.time_place_scope: Taiping, the 1890s
tuples.mechanism: sickness cut working days, so owners funded clinics to protect the advances they had paid
tuples.evidence_lens: hospital admission books set against mine payrolls, whose mortality rates historians read very differently

tuples.episode_object: a treaty engagement placing an adviser beside a ruler
tuples.time_place_scope: Pangkor and Perak, 1874
tuples.mechanism: an adviser system let outsiders settle mining disputes and steer revenue to a protector
tuples.evidence_lens: the engagement text checked against the adviser's first revenue and mining reports

tuples.episode_object: a headman's tally board counting baskets of ore
tuples.time_place_scope: the Larut workings, the 1870s
tuples.mechanism: payment by the basket pushed gangs to strip easy ground fast and leave it when yields fell
tuples.evidence_lens: tally boards set against the district's recorded ore output by quarter

tuples.episode_object: a society registration certificate lodged with a magistrate
tuples.time_place_scope: the Straits Settlements, the 1890s
tuples.mechanism: registering brotherhoods brought recruitment and dispute settling under official view
tuples.evidence_lens: registration files read against police reports on labour disputes at the pits

tuples.episode_object: a rice ration scale printed on a card
tuples.time_place_scope: the Pahang mines, the 1900s
tuples.mechanism: food supplied by the pit was charged at the pit's price, deepening what a worker owed
tuples.evidence_lens: ration scales set against market rice prices published in the same towns

tuples.episode_object: a chief's toll receipt for ore leaving his district
tuples.time_place_scope: the Klang river route, the 1850s
tuples.mechanism: before written leases, local rulers taxed ore on its way out and financed the diggers
tuples.evidence_lens: toll receipts checked against river traffic counts kept by trading houses at the mouth

tuples.episode_object: a protector's inspection docket from an immigration depot
tuples.time_place_scope: the Chinese immigration depots at Singapore, the 1880s
tuples.mechanism: inspecting depots checked consent on paper while leaving the debt that shaped it intact
tuples.evidence_lens: inspection dockets read against the depot keepers' own contract ledgers

tuples.episode_object: a printed daily tin quotation from a metal exchange
tuples.time_place_scope: London and Penang, the 1900s
tuples.mechanism: a distant daily price set what a pit earned, so local costs met a market they could not move
tuples.evidence_lens: exchange quotations checked against mine cost accounts submitted to shareholders

tuples.episode_object: a labour code ordinance printed for employers
tuples.time_place_scope: the Federated Malay States, 1904 to 1914
tuples.mechanism: rules on contracts and penal clauses shifted, slowly ending criminal punishment for quitting
tuples.evidence_lens: the ordinances set against magistrates' desertion case files before and after

tuples.episode_object: a tailings dam wall breached in a wet season
tuples.time_place_scope: the Perak river basin, the 1920s
tuples.mechanism: washing waste silted the rivers, so downstream farmers and fishers paid for upstream output
tuples.evidence_lens: drainage board complaints read against mine tailings discharge records

tuples.episode_object: an export quota certificate under an international scheme
tuples.time_place_scope: Malaya and the tin producing states, the 1930s
tuples.mechanism: producer quotas cut output to lift the price, and the pits shed their workers first
tuples.evidence_lens: quota certificates set against mine employment returns during the same slump

tuples.episode_object: a repatriation passage list for unemployed labourers
tuples.time_place_scope: the Malayan ports, 1931 and 1932
tuples.mechanism: when demand fell, migrant workers were shipped home, exporting the slump to their villages
tuples.evidence_lens: repatriation lists checked against remittance records from the same home districts

tuples.episode_object: a fortress order book opened in a newly taken city
tuples.time_place_scope: Tashkent, 1865 to 1867
tuples.mechanism: conquest installed a military government that taxed trade before any crop policy existed
tuples.evidence_lens: garrison order books set against trade tax receipts filed by the new city administration

tuples.episode_object: a treaty article limiting a khanate's dealings abroad
tuples.time_place_scope: Khiva and Bukhara, 1868 and 1873
tuples.mechanism: protectorates left rulers in place while foreign trade and the rivers passed to the empire

tuples.episode_object: a sack of American upland seed issued to a village
tuples.time_place_scope: the Ferghana valley, the 1880s
tuples.mechanism: new seed raised yields and tied growers to the buyers who supplied it on credit

tuples.episode_object: a survey stake driven at a new canal intake
tuples.time_place_scope: the Hungry Steppe irrigation works, the 1890s
tuples.mechanism: state canals opened dry land, and the water right, not the soil, decided who farmed
tuples.evidence_lens: irrigation survey plans read against settlement allotment lists for the same tracts

tuples.episode_object: a rail freight tariff table for baled fibre
tuples.time_place_scope: the Transcaspian railway, 1888 to 1900
tuples.mechanism: cheap carriage let distant mills outbid local weavers for the region's own fibre
tuples.evidence_lens: freight tariff tables checked against station loading returns for fibre and for grain

tuples.episode_object: a duty schedule taxing fibre imported from abroad
tuples.time_place_scope: Saint Petersburg, in the imperial tariff schedules of the 1880s
tuples.mechanism: a tariff on foreign fibre made home-grown crops pay at prices the world would not give
tuples.evidence_lens: tariff schedules set beside mill purchase prices in the central industrial region

tuples.episode_object: a broker's advance note signed before the sowing
tuples.time_place_scope: the Andijan district, the 1890s
tuples.mechanism: money lent before sowing bought the crop cheap and left price risk with the grower
tuples.evidence_lens: advance notes matched to harvest prices posted at the district exchange

tuples.episode_object: a grain wagon consignment note arriving from the north
tuples.time_place_scope: Turkestan's grain imports, the 1900s
tuples.mechanism: as land turned to fibre, food came in by rail, so a rail failure became a food failure

tuples.episode_object: a statute page defining a governor-general's powers
tuples.time_place_scope: the Turkestan statute of 1886
tuples.mechanism: law made land and water state property, turning customary claims into revocable grants
tuples.evidence_lens: the printed statute compared with local court files where customary claims were argued

tuples.episode_object: an allotment certificate for a plot cut from steppe pasture
tuples.time_place_scope: the Semirechye settler districts, the 1890s
tuples.mechanism: allotting pasture to newcomers cut winter grazing and pushed herders toward wage work
tuples.evidence_lens: allotment certificates read against livestock census returns for the same districts

tuples.episode_object: a mill purchase contract for one season's fibre
tuples.time_place_scope: the Moscow textile mills, the 1890s
tuples.mechanism: mills contracted forward, which pushed their harvest risk back down to the village
tuples.evidence_lens: mill purchase contracts set against ginnery delivery records for the contracted lots

tuples.episode_object: a ginnery boiler licence hung beside the door
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kokand ginning works, the 1900s
tuples.mechanism: cleaning the fibre locally cut freight, so the first factories rose beside the fields
tuples.evidence_lens: boiler licences checked against factory inspectorate returns of workers employed

tuples.episode_object: a caravan toll receipt issued at a river crossing
tuples.time_place_scope: the Amu Darya crossings, the 1870s
tuples.mechanism: old caravan tolls survived beside new rail rates until the two prices could not coexist
tuples.evidence_lens: toll receipts weighed against the railway's own tariff filings for the parallel route

tuples.episode_object: a conscription list drawn up for rear labour service
tuples.time_place_scope: Turkestan in 1916
tuples.mechanism: a wartime call-up for labour service broke a long exemption and set off a wide revolt
tuples.evidence_lens: conscription lists set against refugee registration files, whose casualty totals stay contested

tuples.episode_object: a bread ration card issued in a provincial city
tuples.time_place_scope: Tashkent, 1917 and 1918
tuples.mechanism: when rail supply stopped, a fibre region could not eat the crop it had already planted
tuples.evidence_lens: ration card stubs compared with sown area returns for the preceding seasons

tuples.episode_object: a price board chalked up at a fibre exchange
tuples.time_place_scope: the Tashkent exchange, the 1910s
tuples.mechanism: one posted price steered planting across hundreds of villages within a single week
tuples.evidence_lens: exchange price boards read against district sowing reports filed after the price moved

tuples.episode_object: a land and water decree pasted on a district office wall
tuples.time_place_scope: Soviet Turkestan, 1921 to 1925
tuples.mechanism: redistribution changed who held the plots but kept the same crop and the same buyers
tuples.evidence_lens: reform decrees matched to state buying quotas set for the same districts

tuples.episode_object: a resettlement house plan for families moved off the pit area
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kawerong valley villages, the 1970s
tuples.mechanism: moving villages for the pit created settlements dependent on mine wages alone
tuples.evidence_lens: resettlement house plans compared with village census returns before removal

tuples.episode_object: a coastal survey chart showing new land built from mine waste
tuples.time_place_scope: the tailings delta at the coast, the 1980s
tuples.mechanism: waste built new ground at the river mouth and buried the old fishing flats
tuples.evidence_lens: coastal charts weighed against aerial photographs of the delta over time

tuples.episode_object: an asset inventory of stripped plant and abandoned housing
tuples.time_place_scope: the plant site after abandonment, the 2000s
tuples.mechanism: stripped plant left the site useless for anything else without fresh capital
tuples.evidence_lens: asset inventories compared with insurance schedules filed before the shutdown

coverage_profiles.subject: the coltan and cobalt trade of the eastern Congo

tuples.episode_object: a numbered tag sealed onto a sack of ore at the pit
tuples.time_place_scope: Rubaya in Masisi, from 2012
tuples.mechanism: a numbered seal records each hand-off, so a sack can be traced back to a cleared dig
tuples.evidence_lens: tag issue registers set against export declarations lodged at the provincial mining office

tuples.episode_object: a site validation certificate signed by a joint team
tuples.time_place_scope: North Kivu, 2011 to 2015
tuples.mechanism: teams grade sites green, yellow or red, and only cleared sites may sell into the tagged chain
tuples.evidence_lens: validation reports read against site visit notes from independent civil society monitors

tuples.episode_object: a purchase receipt written out by a buying house
tuples.time_place_scope: Bukavu, the 2000s
tuples.mechanism: price was set by grade at the counter, so a digger's pay turned on an on-the-spot assay
tuples.evidence_lens: counter receipts checked against assay results later recorded by the receiving smelter

tuples.episode_object: an expert panel annex table listing declared exports
tuples.time_place_scope: the Great Lakes region, 2001 to 2003
tuples.mechanism: setting declared exports beside known deposits exposed ore crossing borders before sale
tuples.evidence_lens: panel annex tables set against neighbouring states' customs export statistics

tuples.episode_object: a printed disclosure rule requiring supply chain reporting
tuples.time_place_scope: the United States, 2010 and 2012
tuples.mechanism: listed importers had to report where certain metals came from, pushing audits down the chain
tuples.evidence_lens: the rule text read against the first filings companies submitted under it

tuples.episode_object: a due diligence guidance booklet with a five step chart
tuples.time_place_scope: Paris, 2011 and 2016
tuples.mechanism: a voluntary framework told buyers to map risks and report, rather than to quit the region
tuples.evidence_lens: the guidance editions set against industry scheme rules that adopted its language

tuples.episode_object: a conformance list entry naming a processing plant
tuples.time_place_scope: the smelters of Southeast Asia and China, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: auditing refiners rather than pits made a few plants the checkpoint for a very wide base
tuples.evidence_lens: conformance lists checked against independent audit summaries published for the same plants

tuples.episode_object: a suspension order closing artisanal digging in three provinces
tuples.time_place_scope: the eastern Congolese provinces, 2010 and 2011
tuples.mechanism: a blanket ban cut legal buying, and diggers went on working through informal channels instead
tuples.evidence_lens: the suspension order read against household income surveys taken during the closure

tuples.episode_object: timber shoring propping a hand dug shaft
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kolwezi artisanal sites, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: shallow hand digging needs no capital, so output tracks price and stops when buyers leave
tuples.evidence_lens: site inspection dockets set against monthly buying station volumes

tuples.episode_object: a cooperative membership card issued to a digger
tuples.time_place_scope: Lualaba province, from 2016
tuples.mechanism: registering diggers in cooperatives gave a lawful route to sell and a body to tax and inspect
tuples.evidence_lens: membership registers checked against cooperative sales records at the official buying centres

tuples.episode_object: a state agency purchase order for artisanal output
tuples.time_place_scope: Kinshasa and the copper provinces, 2019 to 2021
tuples.mechanism: routing artisanal ore through one official buyer set a single price and one record of sale
tuples.evidence_lens: agency purchase orders read against reported artisanal export volumes for the same months

tuples.episode_object: a border post truck manifest for mineral cargo
tuples.time_place_scope: the Goma and Gisenyi crossing, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: price and tax gaps across a border pull ore toward the cheaper exit, whatever its origin
tuples.evidence_lens: border manifests set against production declarations from the mines named on them

tuples.episode_object: a battery cathode specification sheet naming metal content
tuples.time_place_scope: the cell plants of East Asia, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: cell chemistry decides how much of a metal each car needs, so design choices reach the pit
tuples.evidence_lens: cathode specifications checked against refined metal import statistics by chemistry type

tuples.episode_object: a weighbridge ticket printed at a trading depot
tuples.time_place_scope: Kalemie and the lakeside depots, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: weight logged at the depot rather than the dig leaves a gap where sacks can be mixed
tuples.evidence_lens: weighbridge tickets read against tag records issued upstream for the same consignments

tuples.episode_object: a reference price notice posted at a buying centre
tuples.time_place_scope: Kolwezi buying centres, 2019 to 2022
tuples.mechanism: publishing a reference price gave diggers a benchmark but not the power to hold out for it
tuples.evidence_lens: posted reference prices set against actual receipts issued to diggers on the same days

tuples.episode_object: a concession boundary marker beside a village of pits
tuples.time_place_scope: the Lualaba concessions near Kasulo, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: where formal titles overlap dug ground, residents face relocation and a compensation fight
tuples.evidence_lens: concession maps checked against resettlement compensation registers for the affected households

tuples.episode_object: a scheme audit docket covering a tagging operator
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kivu tagging sites, 2017 to 2020
tuples.mechanism: auditing the auditors matters, because a seal is worth only the checks standing behind it
tuples.evidence_lens: scheme audit dockets read against the tag issuance data those sites reported

tuples.episode_object: a customs export declaration for tantalum bearing ore
tuples.time_place_scope: the Congolese export offices, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: export paperwork fixes an official origin, which is where any chain of custody claim begins
tuples.evidence_lens: export declarations set against importing countries' mirror trade statistics

tuples.episode_object: a road repair contract on a mineral haulage route
tuples.time_place_scope: the Walikale road to Bisie, 2012 to 2018
tuples.mechanism: a passable road drops haulage cost, which changes which deposits are worth working at all
tuples.evidence_lens: road contracts checked against transport cost surveys collected along the same route

tuples.episode_object: a recycling plant intake sheet for used battery packs
tuples.time_place_scope: European recovery plants, the 2020s
tuples.mechanism: metal recovered from cells competes with fresh output, so recycling shapes long run demand
tuples.evidence_lens: plant intake sheets read against refined metal demand forecasts published by industry bodies
